checks.q: Is the price feed staleness check implemented with appropriate heartbeat?
Is the L2 sequencer uptime feed checked before using price data?
Are price feed decimal conversions handled correctly?
Is the round completeness check implemented (answeredInRound >= roundId)?
Are multi-hop price derivations (e.g., TOKEN/ETH * ETH/USD) correctly calculated?
Is the min/max price check implemented to detect circuit breaker triggers?
Are fallback oracles configured for critical price feeds?
Is the price feed address verified against Chainlink's official registry?
Is the price update frequency appropriate for the use case?
